Actual MCP context, plan persistence and readback succeeded.';fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(r,null,2)+'\n');console.log(JSON.stringify({preflightPassed:r.preflightPassed,arms:r.pairs.map(x=>({arm:x.arm,mcpCalls:x.run.itemCounts.mcp_tool_call||0,planSaved:x.capture.tasks?.some(t=>t.planPresent)||false}))}));if(!r.preflightPassed)process.exitCode=1;
